en.title: Results show the team a rider rode for
en.body: Stage results, latest results and race history now show the team the rider was on in that race, also after he changed team.

da.title: Resultater viser holdet, rytteren kørte for
da.body: Etaperesultater, seneste resultater og løbshistorik viser nu det hold, rytteren kørte for i løbet, også efter et holdskifte.
